integrity: The result has an analytical proof with supplementary finite numerical checks, not an external or formal certificate.
limitations: Periodicity and level-homogeneous offspring counts are essential; no general irregular-tree formula is claimed.
The critical coefficient is pointwise for fixed branching pattern; no bound uniform in period or maximum offspring degree is claimed.
General periodic operator/Floquet literature may contain abstract equivalents; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp Floquet conditioning and branching-order instability for periodic tree shifts
